KANEKI

金木研a study in ink. scroll
chapter 01

Before the mask,a boy, a paperback,a coffee going cold.

chapter 02

They rewrote him, one panel at a time.

The ink gets darker. The margins close in. A quiet student stops being one.

chapter 03

Something answers.

One eye turns red, and it doesn’t ask permission.

KAGUNE
chapter 04

Hunger, with a shape.

What he carries now is bigger than the boy who carried books.

chapter 05

Ghoul.

Half human, half hunger. Both are still him.
